A [retained ChatGPT CRM answer](https://zenodo.org/records/22907695/files/answers-2026-09.jsonl?download=1) from 22 September 2026 puts its HubSpot Sales Hub shortlist statement beside a link to `https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales`; its saved citation list also contains that address. This lets a reviewer connect an actual sentence with an attached destination. The record contains the answer and returned links, not the rewritten search queries or ranking weights, so that visible pairing cannot explain why the system chose the page or verify the product description.
